concept.hr: HITNO prekida, prioritet određuje red, tek ACK isporučuje poruku
concept.en: HITNO preempts, priority sets the order, only an ACK delivers

summary.hr: Ubaci poruke četiriju prioriteta u usmjerenu mrežu: HITNO prekida poruku na kanalu, NCS može ograničiti promet, a bez ACK-a se ponavlja pa ide releju.
summary.en: Inject four priorities of traffic into a directed net: HITNO cuts what is on the air, the NCS can restrict traffic, no ACK means retry, then a relay.

concept.hr: HITNO prekida rutinsku poruku na kanalu i potvrđen je u 6. odsječku
concept.en: A HITNO cuts off the routine message on the air and is ACKed in slot 6

concept.hr: Isti promet redom prijave: HITNO čeka svoj red do 8. odsječka
concept.en: The same traffic in order of registration: the HITNO waits until slot 8

concept.hr: Četiri prioritetne poruke istodobno: po pozivnom znaku, informativna zadnja
concept.en: Four priority messages at once: by call sign, the informational one last

concept.hr: Tri pokušaja bez ACK-a, zatim relej: isporučeno u 10. odsječku
concept.en: Three tries with no ACK, then a relay: delivered in slot 10
